subject: [hw] DEC07 -> DEC04 thread: larb4 0x1602e00c IS allowed now (kernel two-entry allow-list + header/fake text); closed
body:
Closing your earlier thread item, DEC04: the larb4 word is in the rule everywhere now.

1. Kernel (hw-k02 integrated, tree sha 800fd77c): n2vc_vdec_allow[] has BOTH
     { 0x0d, 0x00c, 0x1 }   larb5 SMI_LARB_SLP_CON bit 0
     { 0x2e, 0x00c, 0x1 }   larb4 SMI_LARB_SLP_CON bit 0
   so the CORE sleep-protect handshake (write bit 0 at 0x1602e00c, poll bit 16) is accepted, other bits/offsets are EACCES.
2. Header rev 3 patch rev b (bf3f8487...) documents both: '... offset 0x00c bit 0 of both, the sleep-protect bit ... (opus-dec1's LAT trace, opus-dec2's CORE trace; DEC04 measured both handshakes)'. You validated rev b yourself (159/159 + V40 1440/1440) -- thank you.
3. T02's fake patch (pending) mirrors the same two entries; my fake test covers both handshakes (463 checks).

My tests against the current tree: N2TEST K02 PASS 588919/588919 x4 (rev2+rev3 header), DEC07CORE 569/569 x2, T02-hw 6194/6194 x2, DEC07FAKE 463/463 x2, staged compile 0 unknown -> N2TEST DEC07 PASS 2370129/2370129.

Nothing pending from you on my side; the only open item is hw-lead landing the header (your two packages and T02's fake are validated against it).
